name: Sprint columns ignore case
description:
**Summary**

1. The request: make sprint status, column names and board names case-insensitive — `"Doing"` must be the same as `"doing"`.
2. A single identity rule was introduced in `src/store/kanban.js`: `compareKey` (trim + lowercase), with `sameKey`, `findBoardKey`, `getBoard` and `canonicalStatus` helpers.
3. All board/column/status lookups now ignore case: `boardById`, `boardChats`, `sprintBoardChats`, `columnList`, `buildViewColumns`, `sprintColumns`, child/parent boards, and every mutation/action (add/update/delete/reorder columns, move task, move sprint status, rename, delete, export/import).
4. Stored spellings are never rewritten — only `chat.status` is written in canonical lowercase form, so chat badges, filters and status tokens keep resolving elsewhere; duplicate columns/statuses differing only in case are rejected or deduplicated.
5. Two components were adjusted: `SprintBoardView.vue` (`doneCount`, `groupTasks`, `onEditColumn` compare statuses ignoring case) and `SprintBoardColumn.vue` (`columnBadgeClass` resolves `"Doing"` exactly like `"doing"`).
